title: 第六章 月夜惊鸿
novel_title: 穿书被杀妻证道？魔尊追妻夜夜哄
content_zh:
谢清猗心下一紧，有些紧张地朝旁边挪开些许距离，素手无意识地攥住了衣袖，衣袖上绣着的淡色昙花在灯下流光萦绕，“你找到我……是不是，后悔卖掉那个炼丹炉了？”声音放得很轻，带着小心与委屈。

    难道他认得这具身体的原主？还是，认错了人，此刻想要追回那炼丹炉？

    青年将谢清猗这番防备全看在眼里，唇角掠过一抹似有若无的笑意，并不作答，只拿那双深邃的眸子静静地锁着她，让她无处可躲。

    谢清猗本想理直气壮地驳他一句“卖出去的东西，哪有要回去的道理！”可话至嘴边，却被对方那倏然一笑尽数堵了回去。

    那笑意如潋滟春光，破开冰霜，直直撞入心扉，谢清猗只觉呼吸一窒，她不禁暗恼，真是！祸水。

    被他目光笼罩，她心慌意乱地垂下头，羽睫轻颤，假意研究指间戒指，连声音都透着自己都未察觉的紧绷：“所以，你找到我，不是因为后悔卖炼丹炉了？”

    “不。”男子将谢清猗心虚的小动作看在眼里，从容不迫地又朝她欺近几分，两人衣袂几乎相触，他唇角那缕笑意分毫未减，“你只需，为我炼丹便可。”

    听到这个回答时，她恰好抬头，不偏不倚撞进一双近在咫尺的深眸里，呼吸霎时交缠，他身上那股清冽气息扑面而来。视线相触的瞬间，犹如星火猝然坠入寒潭，一道惊雷在她心底炸开，震得心跳骤然失序。

    谢清猗能清晰地感觉到自己的心跳快得不成章法，咚咚作响，连指尖都难以自抑地微微颤抖起来。

    天呐，她都感觉自己不敢呼吸了……他绝对是故意的！可若说这是在撩拨她，不，像他这样的人，一举一动必然另有深意。

    她二十多年从未体会过何为心动，看帅哥如赏花，纯粹欣赏，如今这般失控，令她无措，这具身体总不可能有心脏病吧？

    男子见少女面泛红霞，素手轻按心口，似是气息不匀，不禁微蹙眉头：“你怎么了？”话音未落，修长的手指已自然抬起，指尖带着夜露般的凉意，轻触她的额间。

    谢清猗却觉得被他触碰的肌肤滚烫如火，慌忙侧过脸去，声如蚊蚋：“没，没事，只是有些热。”窗外月色无声流淌，映得她脖颈纤白。

    “慕宸。”清冷的嗓音恰似月下流水，拂过她的耳畔。

    “什么？”谢清猗茫然转回头，唇瓣却不经意擦过他正要收回的指尖，微凉与柔软的触感同时传递，二人俱是一怔。

    鼻尖萦绕着他指尖清冽的冷香，如雪后初霁的崖柏，她竟鬼使神差地，舌尖轻触过那微凉的指尖。

    反应过来的她脑中“轰”的一声……她在干嘛！亲了人家手指头？！简直社死了这一刻，她连自己埋哪儿都想好了，或许，可以给他解释是嘴唇不小心抽筋了？

    指尖传来的湿软触感让他呼吸几不可察地一滞，他猛地收回手，宽大的玄袖掩去了指尖，嗓音比之前冷硬了几分，重复道：“慕宸。”

    他蓦地转头望向窗外沉沉的夜色，仿佛被什么东西牢牢吸住了视线，唯有那悄然泛红的耳廓，泄露了半分心绪。

    指尖那柔软湿滑的触感，却如一条灵蛇，悄然钻入心底，于寒潭深处搅乱一池静水。

    谢清猗敏锐地捕捉到他耳际那抹薄红，原来对方并非全然无动于衷……这个发现非但没能让她宽慰，反而想起自己前面的举动，更是羞得无地自容，今天真是所有的脸都丢没了，好想哭。
content_en:
Xie Qingyi's heart tightened, and he nervously moved a little distance to the side. He unconsciously grasped the sleeves with his bare hands. The light-colored epiphyllum embroidered on the sleeves lingered under the lamp. "When you found me...do you regret selling the alchemy furnace?" His voice was very soft, with caution and grievance.

    Could it be that he recognized the original owner of this body? Or, have you admitted the wrong person and now want to recover the alchemy furnace?

    The young man saw all Xie Qingyi's precautions in his eyes, and a faint smile flashed across his lips. He did not answer, but locked his deep eyes on her quietly, leaving her nowhere to hide.

    Xie Qingyi wanted to retort to him confidently, "There is no reason to take back what you have sold!" But when the words came to his mouth, he was blocked by the other party's sudden smile.

    That smile was like spring light, breaking through the frost and hitting her heart. Xie Qingyi felt her breath suffocate. She couldn't help but feel annoyed, it was true! Disaster.

    Covered by his gaze, she lowered her head in panic, her eyelashes trembled slightly, and she pretended to study the ring on her finger. Even her voice showed a tension that she was not aware of: "So, you found me, not because you regret selling the alchemy furnace?"

    "No." The man noticed Xie Qingyi's guilty actions and calmly moved closer to her. Their clothes were almost touching, and the smile on his lips did not diminish at all. "All you need is to make elixirs for me."

    When she heard this answer, she happened to raise her head and looked right into a pair of deep eyes that were close at hand. Her breaths instantly intertwined, and the cool breath of his body hit her face. The moment their eyes met, it was like a spark suddenly falling into a cold pool, and a thunder exploded in her heart, causing her heartbeat to suddenly go out of order.

    Xie Qingyi could clearly feel that his heartbeat was pounding so fast and chaotically that even his fingertips could not help but tremble slightly.

    God, she felt like she didn't dare to breathe... He definitely did it on purpose! But if he said this was teasing her, no, for a person like him, every move must have a deeper meaning.

    She has never experienced the feeling of heartbeat in more than 20 years. Looking at handsome men is like admiring flowers, purely admiring them. Now that she is so out of control, she is at a loss. There is no way this body has a heart disease, right?

    The man saw the girl's face flushed, her bare hands gently pressing her heart, her breath seemed to be uneven, and he couldn't help but frowned slightly: "What's wrong with you?" Before he finished speaking, his slender fingers naturally lifted up, and with the coolness of night dew on his fingertips, he lightly touched her forehead.

    However, Xie Qingyi felt that the skin he touched was as hot as fire. She hurriedly turned her face to the side and said in a voice like a gnat: "No, it's okay, it's just a little hot." The moonlight flowed silently outside the window, reflecting the delicate whiteness of her neck.

    "Mu Chen." The cold voice was like water flowing under the moon, brushing against her ears.

    "What?" Xie Qingyi turned around blankly, but her lips inadvertently brushed against the fingertips he was about to retract, sending a cool and soft touch at the same time. Both of them were startled.

    The cold fragrance of his fingertips lingered on the tip of her nose, like thuja in the early morning after snow. She unexpectedly touched the slightly cool fingertips with her tongue.

    When she reacted, there was a "boom" in her head... What is she doing! Kissed someone's finger? ! At this moment of death, she had even thought about where to bury herself. Perhaps, she could explain to him that her lips had cramped accidentally?

    The wet and soft touch from his fingertips made his breath almost imperceptibly stagnate. He suddenly retracted his hand, covered his fingertips with his wide black sleeves, and repeated in his voice, which was a little colder than before, "Mu Chen."

    He suddenly turned his head and looked out the window at the dark night, as if his eyes were firmly attracted by something. Only the quietly reddened ears revealed half of his emotions.

    The soft and slippery touch on the fingertips is like a spiritual snake, quietly worming its way into the heart, disturbing a pool of still water deep in the cold pool.

    Xie Qingyi keenly caught the faint redness in his ears, and it turned out that the other party was not completely indifferent... This discovery not only failed to comfort her, but she thought of her previous actions, and even felt ashamed. She really lost all her face today, and really wanted to cry.
title_en: Chapter 6: Jinghong on a moonlit night
